raw: {"analysis":"FFD provides a more complete and accurate plan that addresses all repository facts and ticket requirements. It correctly sequences the work (config first, backfill after 90-day verification), handles the CI cost constraint with pre-merge local validation, accounts for the Thursday flaky check, respects the Sunday maintenance window for schema changes, and clearly flags the irreversibility of backfill. GBM has some issues: it incorrectly states backfill cannot start until 90 days post-launch (the ticket says backfill begins once dual-writing is stable, with 90 days of LegacyStream write capability for query parity verification), and its Lane B/C sequencing is somewhat muddled. FFD also better addresses the compliance report requirement as a deliverable before closing the ticket.","verdict":"FFD"}
